title: Projection from a geometrically irreducible factor induces a bijection on irreducible components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For schemes X and Y over k with X geometrically irreducible, the lemma shows that the projection from the product to Y induces a bijection between irreducible components (statement lines 1379-1389). The proof verifies the three hypotheses of the topological criterion for open maps with irreducible fibres: the scheme theoretic fibres are base changes of the geometrically irreducible X along field extensions, hence irreducible; they are homeomorphic to the set theoretic fibres; and the projection is open because a scheme over a field is universally open over the base (proof lines 1391-1401). The claim is H2: three verifications followed by one topological input, with the base change description of the fibres as the observation that makes geometric irreducibility the right hypothesis.
